about: The workflow films' sound-effect set (lane sfx, 20 Nov 2026; owner: the SFX were 'weird sounds ... not related at all', they 'need to be high quality'). Every row is a purpose-made editing effect read by a model from its source title (class, family, what it is) and measured by signal in sfx_set.py (bandwidth, codec wall, noise floor, clipping, tail, length, tonality). Object recordings carry a family and answer only the picture that shows the object. The audio lives only in the local set folder (VALMERA_SOUNDS), never in git. Mixkit rows: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (free for commercial use, no attribution). lib rows: the product library's own recordings (CC0 Freesound, Sonniss GameAudioGDC), copied unchanged.
